object.description: Make a clone whose root folder can't be listed (Windows: deny List folder on the root with icacls; POSIX: chmod 0o311). Start the installed mellon-mcp with --repo-root naming it, and write initialize to its standard input. Expected: exit status 2 and empty standard output. Restore the permissions in teardown.
